definition: Television programming selects, schedules, or commissions content for a television channel or service to meet audience and operational goals.
entry_text: Television programming selects, schedules, or commissions content for a television channel or service to meet audience and operational goals.
example: A scheduler places a weekly documentary in a time slot where its intended audience is likely to watch.
label: Television programming
sense_note: Could also denote the television content itself; interpreted as the work of organizing it.
